Hi Sarah, John, Priya — I'm setting up **next week's CSE455 staff meeting** (Mon 23–Fri 27).

Looking at the Professor's calendar, the free windows inside working hours are thin:
- Tue 11:00–11:30 and Tue 15:00–15:30
- Wed 10:00–10:30 and Wed 13:00–13:30

My plan: **Wednesday 13:00–13:30**, right after the research meeting and just before guest lecture prep, so the meeting doesn't break up the Professor's lecture blocks.

If that works for all three of you, say so and I'll book it. If it clashes, tell me which of the other windows suits you and I'll move it there.

Hi Alvarez — checked Priya's calendar: **Wednesday 13:00–13:30 is free**, no clash (it sits after the 12:30–13:00 focus block and before the 13:30 research meeting). Works for Priya.

For what it's worth, all four windows you listed are free on Priya's side, so if Sarah or John need a different one, Priya can move to whichever suits them (Tue 11:00–11:30 / Tue 15:00–15:30 / Wed 10:00–10:30 / Wed 13:00–13:30).

Go ahead and book Wednesday 13:00–13:30 — tell me when it's confirmed and I'll put it in Priya's calendar. (Priya only works Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00, and this is inside those hours, so fine.)

Hi Alvarez — Wednesday 13:00–13:30 works for me: it's free in my calendar and inside working hours, and I'm fine having the staff meeting there.

Two small notes, in case it matters for booking:
- Tue 11:00–11:30 isn't actually free for me — my Reading group runs 11:00–11:50. Tuesday's only real window on my side is 15:00–15:30.
- I can only see my own (John's) calendar, not the Professor's; on mine, Wed 10:00–10:30 and Wed 13:00–13:30 are the free slots you listed.

So: Wednesday 13:00–13:30, yes — please go ahead and book it.

Thanks Priya — noted, and good to know you're flexible. I'll lock in Wednesday 13:00–13:30 and confirm here once Sarah and John have weighed in; if they need a different window I'll take you up on the flexibility and tell you straight away.
Thanks John — Wednesday 13:00–13:30 it is, and noted on Tuesday (I'll keep Tue 15:00–15:30 as the fallback, not 11:00). I'll confirm once Sarah has answered.

Hi Alvarez — Wednesday 13:00–13:30 works for me, no clash.

For reference, all four windows you listed are free on my side as well (Tue 11:00–11:30, Tue 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30, Wed 13:00–13:30), so any of them is fine — Wednesday 13:00–13:30 is my first choice too.

Go ahead and book it; I'll block it and log it in my calendar as soon as you confirm.

Just to close the loop, Alvarez — Sarah's answer went out a moment ago and may have crossed with your messages: **Wednesday 13:00–13:30 works for Sarah, no clash.** So all three of us are in. Book it whenever you're ready and I'll block it in Sarah's calendar.

Booked and confirmed ✅

**CSE455 staff meeting — Wednesday 13:00–13:30**, on the Professor's calendar now (right after the 12:30–13:00 research meeting, before guest lecture prep). Sarah, John and Priya: please block it on your side.

Thanks all — that was quick.
Got it, Sarah — our messages crossed. It's booked: **Wednesday 13:00–13:30**, CSE455 staff meeting, on the Professor's calendar. Please block it in yours. See you all Wednesday.
Blocked on John's side ✅ — Wednesday 13:00–13:30, CSE455 staff meeting, and logged in the calendar. See you all Wednesday.
**Blocked on Priya's side ✅** — Wednesday 13:00–13:30, CSE455 staff meeting, in the calendar and logged. See you all Wednesday.
Blocked in Sarah's calendar: Wednesday 13:00–13:30 — CSE455 staff meeting. Logged. Thanks Alvarez — see you Wednesday.
